title: Plot twist: she thinks YOU'RE mad 😅 #shorts
description:
She replied "ok." and you spiraled all night. Meanwhile she was on a crowded bus, typing with one thumb… now wondering if YOU are mad at HER. Researchers call it the liking gap: people like us more than we think. 😅 Send this to the friend you overthink about.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/1nVuUlwU6Vk

#psychology #overthinking #shorts
tags: is my friend mad at me
